body: import { onScopeDispose, readonly, shallowRef, toValue, watchEffect } from 'vue';
Composable file (TypeScript).description:
Complete typed composable: the argument accepts a value, a ref or a getter, the effect cleans up its own request, and the returned state is read-only so only this composable writes it. Requires vue and a request function of your own.

完整的类型化组合式函数：参数同时接受值、ref 与 getter，副作用自行清理请求，返回的状态为只读，写入权只留在函数内部；需要 vue，以及自建的请求函数。

body: import { onScopeDispose, readonly, shallowRef, toValue, watchEffect } from 'vue';
Composable file (JavaScript).description:
Complete composable: the argument accepts a value, a ref or a getter, the effect cleans up its own request, and the returned state is read-only so only this composable writes it. Requires vue and a request function of your own.

完整的组合式函数：参数同时接受值、ref 与 getter，副作用自行清理请求，返回的状态为只读，写入权只留在函数内部；需要 vue，以及自建的请求函数。

Composable accepting a ref or getter.description:
Read an argument that may be a value, a ref or a getter, and react to it changing. Wrapping toValue in a getter is what makes the watcher track it. Requires toValue and watch from vue.

读取可能是值、ref 或 getter 的参数并对其变化作出响应；把 toValue 包在 getter 里才能让侦听器追踪到它；需要 vue 的 toValue 与 watch。

Composable scope cleanup.description:
Release a resource when the surrounding scope ends. Unlike onUnmounted this also fires for a manually created effectScope, so the composable works outside a component too. Requires onScopeDispose from vue.

在所属作用域结束时释放资源；与 onUnmounted 不同，它对手动创建的 effectScope 同样生效，因此组合式函数在组件之外也能正常清理；需要 vue 的 onScopeDispose。

Composable detached effect scope.description:
Group several effects so they can be disposed together, for state that outlives one component or is created on demand. Requires effectScope and onScopeDispose from vue.

把若干副作用归入一个作用域以便统一销毁，适用于生命周期长于单个组件、或按需创建的状态；需要 vue 的 effectScope 与 onScopeDispose。

Composable shared singleton.description:
Create a composable's state once and hand the same instance to every caller. The detached scope keeps it alive after the first component unmounts. Requires effectScope from vue.

只创建一次状态并把同一实例交给所有调用方；分离的 effectScope 使其在首个组件卸载后依然存活；需要 vue 的 effectScope。
